feature: Demand factor breakdown per zone/density and per resource
why_it_matters: Demand bars alone do not say whether to cut taxes, build schools, zone, or wait. The game already computes signed factors (EmptyBuildings, Taxes, Happiness, Workforce, LocalDemand, ...) per density and per resource.
game_mechanism: ResidentialDemandSystem.GetLow/Medium/HighDensityDemandFactors + householdDemand; CommercialDemandSystem.GetDemandFactors/GetResourceDemands/companyDemand; IndustrialDemandSystem.GetIndustrialDemandFactors/GetOfficeDemandFactors/GetResourceDemands/storageCompanyDemand; Game.Prefabs.DemandFactor enum
suggested_endpoint: GET /demand -> {residential:{low,medium,high:{factor:value}, household}, commercial:{factors, perResource}, industrial:{...}, office:{...}, storage}

feature: Income and expense per source (+ loan state)
why_it_matters: The mayor budgets from cash flow; totals hide which taxes, fees, imports, subsidies and tile upkeep drive the balance.
game_mechanism: CityServiceBudgetSystem.GetIncome(IncomeSource)/GetExpense(ExpenseSource)/GetMoneyDelta; IncomeSource (14) and ExpenseSource (15) enums; LoanSystem.CurrentLoan/Creditworthiness
suggested_endpoint: GET /finance -> {income:{source:amount}, expenses:{source:amount}, balance, moneyDelta, loan, creditworthiness}

feature: City statistics and time series
why_it_matters: Unemployed count, workers, homeless, births/deaths, moved in/away with MovedAwayReason, tourists and tourist income, lodging, passengers per mode, cargo per mode, crime rate, wellbeing/health levels: the core KPIs of every alderman, all already tracked by the game.
game_mechanism: CityStatisticsSystem.GetStatisticValue/GetStatisticValueLong(StatisticType, parameter) and the CityStatistic history buffers; Game.City.StatisticType (62 values); Game.Agents.MoveAwayReason

feature: City policies: list + toggle + slider
why_it_matters: 22 policies exist and none has ever been used (Advanced Pollution Management, City Promotion, Import City Services, Pre-Release Programs, High-Speed Highways, Taxi Base Fare). City-wide ones need no districts.
game_mechanism: PolicyPrefab/PolicyData/PolicySliderData; CityOptionData/CityModifierData; Locked on the policy prefab; City entity buffer Game.Policies.Policy {m_Policy, m_Flags, m_Adjustment}; Game.UI.InGame.PoliciesUISystem.SetCityPolicy(policy, active, adjustment)

feature: Service fees read/write
why_it_matters: Fees are a direct income lever and change consumption (water fee also cuts sewage), company/service efficiency, happiness (ElectricityFee/WaterFee factors) and education dropout.
game_mechanism: Game.City.ServiceFee buffer on the city; ServiceFeeSystem.GetFee/SetFee(PlayerResource, buffer, value), GetServiceFees, GetServiceFeeIncomeEstimate; ServiceFeeParameterData FeeParameters {m_Default, m_Max, m_Adjustable}; PlayerResource (13)

feature: Taxes per education level and per resource, with limits and estimates
why_it_matters: Residential tax is paid per education level and company tax per resource; targeted cuts raise demand/happiness where needed without losing all income. Tax happiness uses per-education multipliers.
game_mechanism: TaxSystem.Get/SetResidentialTaxRate(jobLevel), Get/SetCommercialTaxRate(resource), Get/SetIndustrialTaxRate, Get/SetOfficeTaxRate, GetTaxParameterData limits, GetEstimated*TaxIncome

feature: Jobs vs workforce by education level
why_it_matters: Unemployment is the worst happiness factor now; the fix differs (zone industry vs office vs build schools) depending on which education level is unemployed.
game_mechanism: CountWorkplacesSystem.GetTotalWorkplaces/GetFreeWorkplaces/GetUnemployedWorkspaceByLevel; CountHouseholdDataSystem.HouseholdData (education counts, employable, commuters, homeless, students)
suggested_endpoint: GET /jobs -> per level {workplaces, free, workers, unemployed}, commuters, homeless, students

feature: Happiness factor detail: raw values, base levels, parameters
why_it_matters: /happiness shows averages minus hidden base levels; the council cannot see how far a factor is from its cap or neutral point (Entertainment and Mail are capped) without the parameters.
game_mechanism: CitizenHappinessSystem.GetHappinessFactor; HappinessFactorParameterData.m_BaseLevel/m_LockedEntity; CitizenHappinessParameterData (multipliers, limits, curves); LeisureParametersData

feature: Stuck/teleported citizens and unreachable buildings (TrafficPenalty source)
why_it_matters: TrafficPenalty rose from -0.61 to -0.90 in one day; it is set when a citizen is in a building without road access or a trip finds no path. The same broken connectivity shows as failed pathfinding in post (103), maintenance (843), prisoner transport, garbage and fire requests.
game_mechanism: Citizen.m_PenaltyCounter (set to 255 by CitizenTravelPurposeSystem/CitizenStuckJob and TripNeededSystem/CitizenJob); Building.m_RoadEdge == Null; PathOwner/PathFlags.Failed; ServiceRequest.m_FailCount
suggested_endpoint: GET /stuck -> citizens with penalty by home cell, buildings without road edge, recent failed paths by target cell

feature: Utility building status (power plants, batteries, pumps, outlets, telecom) in /services
why_it_matters: Wind/solar output depends on WindSpeed/SunIntensity efficiency; pumps can deliver dirty water; outlets purification; both incinerators show Powerline Not Connected; battery charge unknown - all invisible today.
game_mechanism: ElectricityProducer {m_Capacity, m_LastProduction}, Battery/BatteryData, WaterPumpingStation {m_Pollution, m_LastProduction}, SewageOutlet {m_LastProcessed, m_LastPurified}, TelecomFacility, Efficiency buffer; ElectricityStatisticsSystem.batteryCharge

feature: Eligible students vs seats per level
why_it_matters: 16 of 21 schools are full with only small schools for ~95k people; without eligible counts the council cannot size new schools.
game_mechanism: EducationInfoviewUISystem (students/eligible/capacity per level); CountStudyPositionsSystem; Citizen education level + Student component

feature: Building actions: Out of Service, Emptying, Historical
why_it_matters: Empty full landfills and cemeteries (2 Cemetery02 full now); idle over-built service buildings to save upkeep; freeze a zoned building (no level change, never abandoned).
game_mechanism: Game.UI.InGame.ActionsSection m_BuildingOutOfServicePolicy / m_EmptyingPolicy via PoliciesUISystem.SetPolicy(building, ...) (BuildingOption Inactive/Empty); BuildingFlags.Historical

feature: Road maintenance separated from park maintenance (+ road wear)
why_it_matters: The /services park 'maintenanceRequests' (802 waiting / 843 failed) are mostly road wear and accident vehicles served by a single Road Maintenance Depot; it is misread as a park problem.
game_mechanism: MaintenanceRequest from ParkAISystem / NetDeteriorationSystem / DamagedVehicleSystem; MaintenanceDepotData.m_MaintenanceType Park|Road|Snow|Vehicle; Game.Net.NetCondition.m_Wear
suggested_endpoint: GET /services?kind=roads (road depots, vehicles, wear histogram, requests by target type)

feature: Tourism status
why_it_matters: City attractiveness follows a saturating logistic and tourists a capped curve (IL); the tourism officer needs attractiveness, tourists vs target, lodging and the top attraction providers with their factors.
game_mechanism: Game.City.Tourism {m_CurrentTourists, m_AverageTourists, m_Attractiveness, m_Lodging}; TourismSystem.GetTargetTourists; AttractivenessProvider; AttractionSystem factors; StatisticType TouristCount/TouristIncome/LodgingUsed/LodgingTotal

feature: Land value map
why_it_matters: Land value drives rent, high-rent warnings, who moves where and which zone succeeds.
game_mechanism: LandValueSystem cell map (LandValueCell.m_LandValue) and Game.Net.LandValue on road edges; LandValueParameterData

feature: Building levels, condition, rent stress and level-up material
why_it_matters: 186 buildings show 'Leveling Building' (waiting for the level-up resource delivery); the planner needs level histograms, buildings near level-up/abandonment, high-rent clusters and which resource is missing.
game_mechanism: SpawnableBuildingData.m_Level, BuildingCondition.m_Condition vs BuildingUtils.GetLevelingCost/GetAbandonCost, ZoneLevelUpResourceData, BuildingUpkeepSystem/LevelUpMaterial, BuildingFlags.HighRentWarning, PropertyRenter.m_Rent
suggested_endpoint: GET /levels -> per zone {levelHistogram, waitingForMaterial:{resource:count}, nearLevelUp, nearAbandon, highRent}

feature: Crime map and per-building crime
why_it_matters: Find crime hotspots and where police coverage, Gated Community or welfare pay off; accumulation = rate x factor x 5/(5+policeCoverage).
game_mechanism: CrimeProducer.m_Crime (cap PoliceConfigurationData.m_MaxCrimeAccumulation), CrimeAccumulationSystem, CrimeVictim, CrimeStatisticsSystem
suggested_endpoint: GET /crime?x&z&size&cell (grid + worst buildings + nearest station status)

feature: Active city and district modifiers
why_it_matters: Shows which policies and city-effect buildings (City Hall, CIB, universities, research) are actually in effect and by how much.
game_mechanism: Game.City.CityModifier buffer (CityModifierType 0-40), Game.Areas.DistrictModifier buffer, prefab CityModifierData/LocalModifierData

feature: Signature buildings: placed vs available
why_it_matters: 13 signature buildings are unlocked; they are free, give XP and local bonuses, and only one of each can exist. The agent cannot tell which are already placed.
game_mechanism: Game.Buildings.Signature on placed buildings, PlacedSignatureBuildingData on the prefab, SignatureBuildingData

feature: Info-view summaries (all in-game info panel numbers)
why_it_matters: One call gives the exact numbers of every in-game info panel: crime rate, criminals, prisoners, eligible students, battery charge, electricity/water import-export, average pollution, fire hazard, shelter use, telecom availability.
game_mechanism: Game.UI.InGame.*InfoviewUISystem bindings (GetterValueBinding read live; ValueBinding refreshed only while active, so compute or force update); ElectricityStatisticsSystem; ElectricityTradeSystem; WaterTradeSystem

feature: Service building upgrades (attach to owner)
why_it_matters: Cheapest capacity in the game: school classroom extensions (8k/40k) while 16/21 schools are full, Prison Extra Wing, WWTP Extra Processing Unit, Solar Backup Battery, Diesel Generator, garages, storage extensions, clinic wing. Also gives XP (XPReason.ServiceUpgrade).
game_mechanism: ServiceUpgrade prefabs placed with an owner (CreationDefinition owner / ObjectDefinition parent), InstalledUpgrade buffer, UpgradeUtils.TryGetCombinedComponent; sub-building area per glossary SubBuildingArea

feature: Traffic flow per road and city average
why_it_matters: Bottleneck icons are lagging and coarse; road flow per edge tells where to widen, add lights or reroute.
game_mechanism: Game.Net.Road.m_TrafficFlowDuration0/1, m_TrafficFlowDistance0/1 (float4 per time slot), TrafficFlowSystem.cityAverageTrafficFlow/Volume, TrafficBottleneckSystem
suggested_endpoint: GET /traffic?x&z&radius -> city average, worst edges by flow, bottlenecks

feature: Per-building happiness breakdown and factor heat map
why_it_matters: City averages hide local pockets; workers need to see where garbage, crime, noise, cramped apartments or telecom hurt.
game_mechanism: Game.UI.InGame.BuildingHappiness.GetResidentialBuildingHappinessFactors / CitizenHappinessSystem.GetBuildingHappinessFactors (BuildingHappinessFactor enum); same per-household terms as CitizenHappinessJob aggregated per cell

feature: Transit line management and non-bus lines
why_it_matters: Ticket price and vehicle count decide ridership vs cost and FeePublicTransport income; train/tram/subway/ship/air lines are needed once unlocked (train 1 pt, harbor 2 pts).
game_mechanism: Route policies RouteModifierType TicketPrice/VehicleInterval via PoliciesUISystem.SetPolicy(route, ...); RouteToolSystem definitions for other TransportType values (same pipeline as /busline)
suggested_endpoint: POST /line {id, ticketPrice, vehicles} ; POST /line {type: train|tram|subway|ship|airplane, stops:[...]}

feature: Loans
why_it_matters: Not needed now (80M cash) but the mayor should be able to borrow for a big build and repay.
game_mechanism: Game.Tools.LoanSystem CurrentLoan, Creditworthiness, RequestLoanOffer(amount), ChangeLoan(amount); interest lerp(m_LoanMinMaxInterestRate) by amount/creditworthiness x CityModifier LoanInterest

feature: Milestone dev points, loan limit; XP reward per prefab
why_it_matters: The planner should know how many development points and how much credit the next milestone gives, and which builds yield most XP.
game_mechanism: MilestoneData.m_DevTreePoints, m_LoanLimit, m_Major; PlaceableObjectData.m_XPReward; PlaceableNetData.m_XPReward
suggested_endpoint: add fields to GET /milestones and GET /prefabs

feature: Natural-resource amounts per candidate map tile
why_it_matters: Choose expansion tiles with fertile land, forest, ore, oil, groundwater for specialized industry and utilities.
game_mechanism: MapTilePurchaseSystem.GetFeatureAmount(MapFeature) on a temporary selection (same path as /buytile dryRun)

feature: Service efficiency preview and staffing per service
why_it_matters: Budget % changes efficiency via a curve; staffing shortfalls cut efficiency too.
game_mechanism: CityServiceBudgetSystem.GetServiceEfficiency(service, budget), GetWorkersAndWorkplaces(buildingPrefab), GetNumberOfServiceBuildings
suggested_endpoint: extend GET /budget with efficiencyAt {50,100,150} and workers/workplaces

feature: Telecom network quality map
why_it_matters: Telecom affects wellbeing, company efficiency and emergency response time; quality = signal vs load, so dense new districts drop below baseline unnoticed.
game_mechanism: TelecomCoverageSystem cell map, TelecomCoverage.SampleNetworkQuality, m_SignalStrength/m_NetworkLoad

feature: Taxi stands and mailboxes as stops
why_it_matters: Taxi stands speed up taxi service; mailboxes collect mail. Both are road-edge stop objects like bus stops (taxi stops are still locked).
game_mechanism: TransportStop prefabs NA/EU_TaxiStop01, PostMailbox01 (RoadEdge|Attached placement) via the ObjectToolSystem path used by /busstop

feature: Flip one-way / asymmetric road direction
why_it_matters: Lane direction is changed by rebuilding the same road in the opposite direction; useful to fix one-way traps behind failed pathfinding.
game_mechanism: CreationDefinition with m_Original = edge and inverted NetCourse (CompositionFlags.General.Invert)

feature: Intersection controls at nodes: traffic lights, all-way stop, turn bans, crosswalks
why_it_matters: /roadupgrades lists these as 'node (not supported here)'; junction control is the main lever against local bottlenecks.
game_mechanism: Node upgrades with CompositionFlags.General TrafficLights/RemoveTrafficLights/AllWayStop; node-end Side flags ForbidLeftTurn/ForbidRightTurn/ForbidStraight/AddCrosswalk/RemoveCrosswalk; NetToolSystem upgrade definitions on nodes

feature: Cargo routes (train, ship, airplane)
why_it_matters: Cargo transport lowers shipping cost and makes companies profitable; all freight is by truck today (No Inputs 16, Leveling Building 186).
game_mechanism: Cargo Train/Ship/Airplane Route prefabs (TransportLineData.m_CargoTransport), cargo stations; RouteToolSystem

feature: Production, consumption and trade balance per resource
why_it_matters: Shows which goods are imported, which shortage blocks companies (No Inputs) and level-ups, and what specialized industry or cargo transport would pay off.
game_mechanism: CityProductionStatisticSystem.GetConsumptionProductions/GetProductionChains; CountCompanyDataSystem.GetProduction/GetTotalSellableInCity; TradeSystem trade balances / GetBestTradePriceAmongTypes

feature: Zoning suitability score at a location
why_it_matters: Pick streets where a zone type will thrive (customers, inputs, land value, pollution, outside connection) before zoning.
game_mechanism: ZoneEvaluationUtils.GetScore/GetFactors with the road-edge ResourceAvailability buffer and ZonePreferenceData; ZoningEvaluationFactor
suggested_endpoint: GET /zonescore?zone=...&x&z&radius -> top edges with score and factors

feature: Surface-water pollution and wind field
why_it_matters: Sewage outlets pollute rivers that feed surface pumps; air pollution drifts with the wind - siting needs both.
game_mechanism: WaterSystem surface data (pollution channel), WaterPumpingStation.m_Pollution, WindSystem.GetWind / Wind cell map

feature: Population distributions
why_it_matters: Averages hide risk: how many citizens are below 30 happiness (move-out), unemployed and for how long, sick, low-health elderly.
game_mechanism: Citizen.m_WellBeing/m_Health/m_UnemploymentTimeCounter, CountHouseholdDataSystem (LowWellbeing/LowHealth statistics), HomelessHousehold
suggested_endpoint: GET /citizens (histograms of wellbeing/health/happiness, unemployed by education and duration)

feature: Districts (list, create, assign policies, service restriction)
why_it_matters: District policies (Speed Bumps, Heavy Traffic Ban, Gated Community, Small Business Enthusiast, Recycling, Energy Awareness, Sprinklers, parking fee) only work inside districts; services can be restricted to districts.
game_mechanism: Game.Areas.District area entity + Policy buffer + DistrictModifier; CurrentDistrict on buildings/edges; ServiceDistrict buffer on service buildings; area creation via CreationDefinition + area nodes

feature: Natural-resource map + specialized industry hub and production area
why_it_matters: No specialized industry exists; raw materials are imported. All nine hub prefabs are unlocked; placing the hub may work via /building (untested), the production polygon does not.
game_mechanism: NaturalResourceSystem cells (m_Fertility/m_Ore/m_Oil/m_Fish), MapTilePurchaseSystem.GetFeatureAmount, ExtractorAreaData, Game.Areas.Extractor, PlaceholderBuildingData; area tool definitions for the polygon
suggested_endpoint: GET /resources?x&z&size&cell ; POST /building with '* Area Placeholder' (verify) ; POST /area {areaPrefab, owner, points}

feature: Company health
why_it_matters: Explains low commercial/office demand and slow leveling; locates failing commercial areas (No Customers 13, No Inputs 16).
game_mechanism: Game.Companies.Profitability, CompanyNotifications, WorkProvider/Employee, ServiceAvailable, TradeCost
suggested_endpoint: GET /companies?zone=commercial|industrial|office -> profitability histogram, worst clusters, missing inputs

feature: Fire hazard map
why_it_matters: 5 industrial buildings burned down; hazard = prefab x level x zone x max(0.01, 1-0.01*coverage) x district modifier - shows where stations or sprinklers help.
game_mechanism: EventHelpers.FireHazardData.GetFireHazard, FireHazardSystem, FireAndRescueInfoviewUISystem.m_AverageFireHazard

feature: Disaster status
why_it_matters: Disasters appear enabled (Weather Destroyed icon) but there are no shelters; the council needs incoming events, danger zones and shelter use.
game_mechanism: Game.Events.WeatherPhenomenon/WaterLevelChange with Duration, InDanger/DangerFlags, EmergencyShelter, DisasterInfoviewUISystem, EventJournalSystem

feature: Electricity grid bottlenecks (flow edges)
why_it_matters: Locate overloaded cables and transformers precisely instead of icons only.
game_mechanism: ElectricityFlowSystem graph, ElectricityFlowEdge flags Bottleneck/BeyondBottleneck/Disconnected, ElectricityConnectionData.m_Capacity

feature: Leisure availability
why_it_matters: Leisure wellbeing (-8..+7) depends on citizens finding leisure providers per LeisureType; we cannot see which types are missing.
game_mechanism: LeisureSystem (FindLeisure/SpendLeisure), LeisureProviderData.m_LeisureType, Citizen.m_LeisureCounter
suggested_endpoint: GET /leisure (avg counter, providers per LeisureType, failed searches)

feature: Landscaping: trees/forest brush, surfaces, terraforming
why_it_matters: Forests raise attractiveness of nearby attractions; surfaces and trees shape green belts in the masterplan.
game_mechanism: Plant object prefabs via ObjectToolSystem brush; SurfacePrefab areas (AreaType.Surface); TerrainSystem brush

feature: Roundabouts and cul-de-sacs (net objects)
why_it_matters: 38 roundabout/cul-de-sac objects are unlocked but not listed by /prefabs and cannot be placed at a node.
game_mechanism: NetObject prefabs placed on a node (ObjectToolSystem with node attachment)

feature: Parking metrics
why_it_matters: Parking search adds traffic; parking lots (locked, 2 pts) and fees are levers once we can see occupancy.
game_mechanism: Game.Net.ParkingLane (free space), Game.Buildings.ParkingFacility, ParkingFacilityData; StatisticType none -> count lanes

feature: Landfill lot (Lot Tool) resize
why_it_matters: Landfill capacity and pollution footprint depend on the drawn lot; /building places a default lot only.
game_mechanism: Landfill storage sub-area (Game.Areas.Storage, StorageAreaData, LotData.m_MaxRadius); area node editing via CreationDefinition + area nodes

feature: Bus stops and bus lines
why_it_matters: Transit cuts traffic, raises land value (bus access bonus) and leaves citizens more money for consumption.
game_mechanism: Transport stop placement via ObjectToolSystem (RoadEdge net object), RouteToolSystem definitions (WaypointDefinition), TransportLine

feature: Find where a building fits (findspot / freeland)
why_it_matters: Large service buildings and hubs fail placement by trial and error; a fit search saves dry runs.
game_mechanism: Zone blocks, terrain steepness, existing objects and road frontage
api_today: merged into Api.cs by the findspot teammate

feature: Road edge upgrades: trees, grass, wide sidewalk, sound barrier, lighting, bike lanes, bus lanes, Road Zones
why_it_matters: Grass/trees on both sides halve a road's noise (IL NetPollutionSystem CheckUpgrades); sound barriers remove it at the sides; bus lanes speed transit.
game_mechanism: Upgraded {CompositionFlags} on edges, PlaceableNetData.m_SetUpgradeFlags/m_UnsetUpgradeFlags, SubReplacement for street trees
